title: Empty Promises
text:
The Rooster and the Hen

The Hen said, “You promise me shoes year after year, year after year, and I never get any shoes!”

The Rooster said, “You’ll get shoes soon enough!”
imagePrompt: Inside a simple farmyard coop, a hardworking hen with bare, dusty feet stands facing a confident rooster. The hen holds her wings out in frustration, her expression tired and fed up, while the rooster stands tall and unbothered, chest puffed as if dismissing her complaint. Straw, a few scattered feathers, and a humble nesting corner set the scene of repeated promises.

title: A Blunt Solution
text:
The Hen said, “I lay eggs, and I do my part, and still I have to go around here barefoot!”

The Rooster said, “Then take your eggs and go to town and buy yourself shoes, and don’t go barefoot anymore!”
imagePrompt: In the farmyard near the path to town, the hardworking hen cradles a small basket of freshly laid eggs, her bare feet planted on the packed earth as she looks determined but annoyed. Beside her, the confident rooster gestures firmly toward the distant town road, as if giving practical instructions. The morning light falls on the eggs and the worn ground under the hen’s feet, emphasizing her need for shoes.
